w:r.w:t: Web: React + Tailwind CSS | App: React Native | Backend: Node.js + PostgreSQL on AWS

COSKINn is a premium, Gen-Z-friendly, fruit-powered skincare and makeup ecommerce brand, launching as an inventory-led / private-label business with a limited, curated product range (12 skincare + 12 makeup SKUs at launch).

This PRD defines what must be built for the first production launch: a customer website (React + Tailwind CSS), a customer mobile app (React Native), and a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend on AWS — including a full customer loyalty and monetary ecosystem (Wallet, Bonus, Referral, Reward Points, Offers, and a tiered Membership program) alongside the operational back-office needed to run the business.

Indian beauty ecommerce is dominated by large multi-brand marketplaces. There is room for a tightly curated, ingredient-story-driven (fruit + skin concern), soft-luxury brand that gives customers a simple, trustworthy, habit-forming shopping experience — with the kind of loyalty mechanics (points, wallet, tiers) that keep shoppers of category leaders like Nykaa coming back.

Become the go-to destination for fruit-based, concern-driven skincare and SPF-safe makeup for value-conscious Gen-Z/young-millennial shoppers in India, with a loyalty program compelling enough to drive repeat purchase from order one.

These sections are additive to the customer panel (app + web), as explicitly requested, and mirror the mechanics used by category-leading beauty apps (e.g. Nykaa Prive), rebuilt under COSKINn's own branding and rules.
System maintains one wallet balance per customer
Balance always equals sum of non-expired ledger entries
Wallet is credited automatically from refunds, bonuses, referral payouts, and reward-point-to-wallet conversions
Each credit is logged with source and reference ID
Customer can apply wallet balance at checkout, partially or fully
Wallet deduction cannot exceed available balance or order value
Wallet credits expire per admin-configured policy
Expired credits are excluded from usable balance automatically
Customer cannot add money to wallet directly
No "add funds" entry point exists anywhere in app/web
New customers receive a sign-up bonus on registration
Bonus credited to Wallet immediately after OTP verification, per admin rule
Customers receive a first-order bonus post-delivery
Bonus credited after the return window closes on the first order
Customers receive a birthday bonus in their birth month
Triggered by a scheduled job; tier-aware multiplier applied
Marketing panel supports creating time-bound bonus rules
Every customer has a unique, shareable referral code/link
Code generated on first login; shareable via native share sheet
Referee gets a welcome discount on first order via referral code
Discount auto-applies when code is used at signup/checkout
Referrer is rewarded once referee's first order is delivered and past return window
Reward (wallet credit or points) posts automatically; visible in referral dashboard
One credited referral per unique verified mobile number/device; minimum order-value threshold enforced
Customer earns 1 reward point per ₹1 of eligible spend
Points credited after return window closes on the qualifying order
Points are redeemable at checkout up to an admin-configured cap
Redemption cannot exceed max % of order value
Points multiply during the customer's birthday month per tier
Points may be locked from redemption during designated sale windows
Admin toggle disables point redemption during flagged campaigns
Expired points are removed from the redeemable balance
Admin can create offers scoped to category, product, payment method, or membership tier
Offer engine evaluates eligibility correctly at cart/checkout time
Homepage displays an active Offers/Deals section
Section reflects only currently valid (in date-range) offers
Best eligible coupon/offer can auto-apply at cart
System selects the highest-value valid offer when multiple qualify, unless customer overrides

A free, auto-enrolling tiered membership program based on rolling 365-day purchase value — the same mechanic used by Nykaa Prive (Member / Gold / Platinum tiers, spend-based auto-upgrade, no joining fee), rebuilt as an original COSKINn program.
Customer is auto-enrolled at Member tier on first ₹1,500 in rolling spend
GST, delivery, and returned items excluded from the spend calculation
Customer is auto-upgraded once threshold is crossed and the qualifying order's return window closes
Notification sent via push/email on upgrade
Customer is auto-downgraded if rolling spend falls below the renewal threshold
Nightly recalculation job updates tier and history log
Customer can view current tier, benefits, and progress to next tier
Membership screen shows a progress bar to next threshold
PLP/PDP pages load in <2s on 4G; API p95 response time <400ms
Backend auto-scales via ECS Fargate; RDS read replica ready for scale-out
